reviews.title: Be careful subscribing
reviews.text:
A 1 star review is too generous. I think this app can put some individuals at risk. 
This app advertises a money back guarantee. You really cannot see if it has all the features you want, or if it is applicable to your individual baseline fitness level until you subscribe. But once you do, they have a very rigid and unreasonable policy regarding their “money back guarantee”. You have to log in and do 8 of their workouts over a very limited length of time.  
Period. It doesn’t matter if their workouts fail to account for your actual fitness level, health issues, etc. Unless you do those 8 workouts within (I think) 2-4 wks, there is NO refund. 
Injury? You’re screwed
Illness? Screwed again
Evident in session 1 that app doesn’t fit your needs?
You guessed it: also screwed. 
Any app, especially a health or fitness one, with such a rigid approach to customer service raises all sorts of red flags for me (esp as a retired physician). Policies that ignore an individual’s health status can lead to injuries, or exacerbation of medical issues. This is irresponsible and dangerous.

reviews.title: Deceptive ad, unwieldy
reviews.text:
First of all the app is awful.  It won’t let you select any weight (or 0 weight). You have to change the “available weights” for every exercise and still it insisted my minimum for a split squat MUST BE 2.5 pounds.  It’s awkward to use and I immediately hated it.  
That said - they absolutely will NOT answer questions (get a robo reply) and will NOT refund your money.  They said I had to use it for eight 1 hour workouts  before they’d consider a refund and then they still ignored the request. I was stupid to even try it.  There’s much better apps available.

I would put in the weight I was using in the machine to get told the weight was wrong!! I have paid a good chunk of money for this app with no free trail and no let down by it all!! I have now cancelled my subscription and also my gym membership due to the fact that this app has knocked my confidence and I feel the gym is not for me if this is what happens when you need support in getting back to health and fitness after being in hospital for over 2 months with sepsis!!!

I told them on day of renewal I don’t wish to renew and pay for another 6 months and they’ve refused me a refund. Very poor customer service. Avoid.

reviews.title: Money Racket - Avoid!
reviews.text:
Signed up for the trial, used a little but didn’t find it useful. Haven’t used for ages. Didn’t get any auto-renew email (which is required in the U.K.) and I contacted them the same day the £49.99 was taken from my credit card to be told they couldn’t refund it. 

I have sent information about the necessity for reminders and if not they need a cooling off-period to allow people to get their money back. Like most users in this situation, no response received!! It’s clear that the reason they don’t provide reminders is to take this money that they then refuse to give back. 

So many better apps out there with good customer support and policies.
